integrity: Original full infinite proof plus separately executable finite checks. No independent audit or certification is claimed.
limitations: Applies to prefixes of the standard Baum–Sweet word and scattered binary subsequences. Counts of shortest absent words and shifted windows are not determined. Originality is supported by inspected literature, not exhaustive of all published or unindexed sources.
title: All-prefix Fibonacci subsequence universality of the Baum–Sweet word
